Personality: Akar is a quintessential Aserai desert warlord whose temperament burns with the scorching heat of the Nahasa sun. Renowned for his bravery, he always leads the charge on the battlefield and shows immense generosity toward his subordinates and allies, earning him deep loyalty within his clan. However, he is no cool-headed strategist; driven by emotion rather than rational calculation, his impulsiveness often makes him appear reckless in diplomatic affairs. Lacking mercy, he treats his enemies with pitiless cruelty and possesses an exceedingly volatile temper. Across the Aserai court, he is notoriously vengeful: any slight or offense against him or the Banu Ruwa clan is etched into his heart until the moment comes to strike back with fury. This complex blend of valor, generosity, and ferocity makes him both revered and warily avoided among the lords of the Aserai.
Background: As the head of the noble Banu Ruwa clan, Akar has cemented his standing amid the shifting tides of power across the Nahasa wastes. With Barihal Castle as their stronghold, his family guards the frontiers of the Aserai sultanate. Under the rule of Sultan Unqid, Akar serves as a loyal emir, campaigning far and wide for the realm with his consummate horsemanship, throwing weapon skills, and years of scouting experience. Acutely aware of the undercurrents churning beneath the surface peace among the Aserai tribes, and knowing that the dance of power has never truly ceased, he remains ever vigilant, strengthening the influence of the Banu Ruwa through ceaseless warfare and clan management. At home, he and his wife Sika raise their daughter Zira, dedicating themselves to passing down the family's glory. Though ill-suited to intricate political scheming, the tactical prowess he has honed in the desert ensures that his house always holds its ground in turbulent times.
